Subject: Embeddings / rerank — MVP checklist & agreed next steps

Hi Alyssa / Evan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick write-up to lock in what we heard and propose an MVP approach so we can move to a short pilot. If anything below is off, please reply inline.

Top pain points you called out
- Relevance drift on category pages during promotions; rerank needs to favor recency + conversion signals.
- Current stack is slowing down under peak load (Black Friday simulations).
- Cost per query and predictability: finance needs a clear unit cost to model margins.

Current environment (what you told us)
- Vector index: Pinecone-managed + a homegrown hybrid layer for business signals.
- Approximate index size: ~140M vectors (product embeddings + session vectors).
- Baseline query load: ~20 QPS average, spikes to ~150 QPS during promotions.
- Embedding generation: OpenAI text-embedding-3-large today for product text. Batch upserts nightly, smaller real-time upserts during the day.

Success criteria for a pilot (we agreed these are measurable)
1) End-to-end P95 latency for rerank queries < 100ms for the MVP index.
2) Relevance uplift >= 8% CTR improvement (A/B) on category pages during promotions.
3) Predictable cost model: target blended cost <= $0.0008 per served query for the pilot workload.
4) Integrations: can be wired into your existing Pinecone flow or read-through cache with minimal schema changes.

Proposed MVP scope (what Redwood delivers)
- Pilot index: isolated 5–10M vector subset representing top-funnel SKUs.
- Integration pattern: use our read-through prefix cache + continuous batching for real-time traffic.
- Perf targets: p95 <100ms, tail mitigation via prefix KV caching.
- Measurement: we will run a 2-week traffic shadow + 1-week canary A/B test.

Operational notes / batch patterns
- Nightly bulk upserts (full refresh window).
- Micro-batches during the day (minutes) to keep session vectors fresh.
- Need of ~1.5x headroom for Black Friday simulation spikes.

Next steps / owners
- Redwood: share an integration checklist + quick SLA (attached) — Tessa (by EOD tomorrow).
- Redwood: perf estimate + sandbox provisioning for a 5M index — Rishi (deliverable: perf spreadsheet and sandbox access).
- Redwood commercial: pricing sketch for pilot and scale tiers — Vanessa (estimate + optional committed offer).
- Atlas: send anonymized query logs and a sample product subset for seeding the pilot (attachment + S3 link).
- Schedule tech deep-dive (Rishi + Atlas infra) — propose Wed 11/11 10am PT.

Attachments included: mvp-integration-checklist.xlsx, redwood-quick-sla.pdf

Thanks all — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
